title: Four of the eleven internal-market purpose hints read as unfinished in the frontend — a misplaced apostrophe, an abbreviation GDS style forbids, and three sentences with no full stop — where DR1 shows them corrected.

finding.frontend: Four hints differ from DR1, all in the frontend's own copy file (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/import-purpose/copy/copy.en.js:6-27). Transfer of ownership - Sale/gift reads 'has as it's aim, the sale of' — a possessive written as a contraction, plus a comma that splits the verb from its object — and closes with '(e.g. a gift)' and no full stop. Breeding ends 'or produce offspring' with no full stop. Racing, competition, show or training ends 'competitive or training events' with no full stop. Production ends 'or by-product' with no full stop. The other seven match DR1 exactly.
finding.prototype: DR1 shows the corrected wording: 'has as its aim the sale of or the transfer of ownership', '(for example a gift).', 'or produce offspring.', 'competitive or training events.' and 'or by-product.' The eleven purposes and their hints live in release-agnostic data, so this is what a DR1 user reads (app/data/internal-market-purposes.js:1-59).
finding.difference: Correct the four hints to DR1's wording: fix the apostrophe and drop the comma in Sale/gift, expand 'e.g.' to 'for example' as GDS style requires, and add the missing full stops to Breeding, Racing and Production. Copy only, one file, no behaviour change. The eleven options, their order and their labels already match, so nothing else on the page moves.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding that DR1's internal-market purposes are rendered from a design-release-specific list, so a DR1 user reads the same uncorrected hints the frontend shows.
